cohort: The study cohort comprised 12,508 multiparous women aged 19-48 years from Dongguan City who achieved pregnancy outcomes within a 1-year follow-up period.
finding: Women with a history of IUD use were found to be less likely to have premature birth after the IUD was removed.
gest_age: All live births from the study population were included; outcomes were defined by gestational age at birth (<37 weeks for preterm birth, <34 weeks for early preterm birth).
